facts.text: Johnson C. Smith University was chartered in 1867 as The Freedmen's College of North Carolina by Presbyterian ministers to educate recently freed enslaved people.

sources.title: Our History | Johnson C. Smith University
sources.quote: In 1867, the Rev. S.C. Alexander and the Rev. W. L. Miller saw the need to establish an institution in the Piedmont region of the South that would deliver education and evangelize to recently freed slaves.
